messages:
tara: Heads-up  I'm reworking the Hello Quickstart to reflect the SDK v9 changes: token-first auth, new env var names, and a shorter Docker -> Cloud Run flow.

lucas: Great. Which env var should we show now?

tara: REDWOOD_TOKEN everywhere (replace REDWOOD_API_KEY). Show both `export REDWOOD_TOKEN=...` and a .env example.

ben: I'll fold that into the code samples. Can we add a minimal Dockerfile we can rely on for snippet tests?

lucas: Minimal Node Dockerfile for docs: 
```
FROM node:20-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production
COPY . .
CMD ["node", "index.js"]
```

tara: Perfect. Also include a curl smoke-check: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` and a tiny note about not committing tokens.

ben: Suggest adding a one-line CLI demo for creating a token so people can avoid the console: `redwoodctl tokens create --title quickstart-demo --output value` then `export REDWOOD_TOKEN=...`. Mark as demo-only.

lucas: Can we add a one-line troubleshooting bullet under Deploy: if you see 401s, confirm REDWOOD_TOKEN is exported in the same shell or container env.

tara: Yes. Also add a CORS one-liner for local demos: "Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *" with a link to the production CORS guide.

docs-bot: Preview published: https://deploy-preview-4899--docs.redwood.ai (preview expires in 15m)

ben: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4412  includes Dockerfile, curl checks, CLI one-liner, and migration callout. Assigning reviewers: @tara @lucas.

lucas: I'll smoke-test the Cloud Run flow and confirm headers are masked in logs tomorrow.

tara: Thanks everyone  will review tonight and merge if clean.
